why_it_works: This ad works through bold humor and taboo-breaking to stop the scroll. By openly discussing bowel movements with the playful headline 'Poop More While On a GLP-1', it addresses a real but rarely discussed side effect of GLP-1 medications (constipation) that the target audience is experiencing. The gummy bear shape makes the topic approachable and less clinical. The benefit stack with familiar comparisons (2 cups of broccoli) provides social proof through 55,000+ reviews while making the solution feel natural and comprehensive rather than just a laxative.
visual_elements: Light sage green background, bold black sans-serif headline typography (heavy weight), green gummy bear product center-right, vertical benefit stack with white rounded rectangles and green backgrounds, small black icons for each benefit, yellow rounded rectangle with 5-star rating at bottom, consistent sans-serif font throughout benefits list
composition: Asymmetrical layout with large headline top-left taking up 40% of space, product image center-right occupying 40% of space, benefit stack running vertically along left side, review badge anchored at bottom center. Square aspect ratio.
angle: Problem-solution with humor. Breaks through embarrassment barrier by making constipation discussable, positioning product as the obvious solution for a specific medication side effect.
audience: Adults taking GLP-1 medications (Ozempic, Wegovy, etc.) for weight loss or diabetes, likely 35-65, health-conscious but experiencing digestive issues, solution-aware and actively seeking relief from constipation side effects

product_presence.description: Large green gummy bear shaped supplement, glossy/shiny texture, positioned as friendly and approachable
